# __PROJECT_NAME__

> An Avalanche confidential-token dapp scaffolded with AvaKit, built on Avalanche's Encrypted ERC (eERC) standard. Register, mint, and privately transfer tokens with hidden balances. Next.js + @avakit/react + @avalabs/eerc-sdk + shadcn/ui.

## Project map

- [lib/eerc-config.ts](lib/eerc-config.ts): `EERC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` (the eERC instance in use; `usesSharedInstance` tells whether it is still the shared demo one) + pinned circuit files with SHA-256 hashes + `loadVerifiedCircuits()` (download → verify → blob URLs, once per page load; tampered CDN copies fail loudly).
- [scripts/deploy-eerc.mjs](scripts/deploy-eerc.mjs): `npm run deploy:eerc` — deploy your own standalone instance to Fuji (mint is owner-only, so this is how mint becomes usable) and point the app at it.
- [app/providers.tsx](app/providers.tsx): `<AvaKitProvider>` (wallet) + `<WagmiProvider>` (required by the eERC SDK's internal reads).
- [components/demo.tsx](components/demo.tsx): register → unlock → mint → confidential transfer → burn.
- [components/funding.tsx](components/funding.tsx): `useFunding()` + `<FundingNotice />` — polls the balance while the wallet is empty, reports the faucet (`useFaucet()`), and disables transaction buttons only while the balance is really zero.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent guide — flow, why this template deviates from AvaKit's usual pattern, how to deploy your own instance.

## Test AVAX

On Fuji, `app/providers.tsx` passes `faucetUrl` to `<AvaKitProvider>`: the temporary wallet is funded automatically when it connects, any other empty wallet through `useFaucet().fund()` ("Get test AVAX"). Default: AvaKit's shared Fuji faucet — rate-limited (one small drip per address per day, plus an hourly cap per IP address), paid for by the AvaKit maintainer, for first runs only. `NEXT_PUBLIC_AVAKIT_FAUCET_URL` = your own faucet's `/fund` URL (Worker in `services/faucet` of the AvaKit repository), or `off`. Never passed off Fuji. Fallback when it refuses: the official faucet (needs a free Builder Hub sign-in). Do not call `fund()` on mount (the provider already asks for the temporary wallet; a second request is refused), and treat `status: "success"` as "sent", not "arrived": wait for a non-zero balance.

## Key APIs

- Init: `useEERC(publicClient, walletClient, EERC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS, circuits)` from `@avalabs/eerc-sdk` — `circuits` is `await loadVerifiedCircuits()` (integrity-checked blob URLs, loaded on mount).
- Register: `eerc.register()` (one-time, on-chain, idempotent).
- Unlock: `eerc.generateDecryptionKey()` (per session, off-chain, no gas).
- Balance + actions: `eerc.useEncryptedBalance()` → `privateMint(to, amount)` (owner-only), `privateTransfer(to, amount)`, `privateBurn(amount)`, `decryptedBalance`, `parsedDecryptedBalance`.
- Owner gating: `eerc.owner`, `eerc.isAuditorKeySet`, `eerc.setContractAuditorPublicKey(address)` — the demo disables Mint unless the connected wallet is the owner AND the auditor key is set (one-click owner step in the UI).
- Amounts are base units (token has 2 decimals) — convert with `parseUnits`/`formatUnits`.

## External docs

- eERC contracts + deploy scripts: https://github.com/ava-labs/EncryptedERC
- eERC SDK: https://avacloud.gitbook.io/encrypted-erc/usage/sdk-overview
- Avalanche Builder Hub: https://build.avax.network/llms.txt
- Official Fuji faucet (needs a free Builder Hub sign-in; the app's temporary wallet is funded without one, see "Test AVAX"): https://build.avax.network/console/primary-network/faucet
- Run your own faucet: https://github.com/mericcintosun/AvaKit/tree/main/services/faucet
